sourceDecisionQuestions.question: The source groups underlayment, sub-capa and felt, while the archive narrows felt paper to feutre bitumé. Confirm the product-specific French senses and whether the six-inch example refers to this layer before scoring.

Six inches is attributed to the guide, then the foreman checks manufacturer instructions. Resolve the approved product overlap; retain the guide example as attributed speech, never a universal installation rule.

Plastic cap nails are an explicit source fastening method, but archive clous à rondelles de plastique may name a different cap/washer form. Confirm the selected product fastener and French term before a scored imperative or audio script.

Archived Reader 5 recasts the guide's six-inch phrase as an example; this is a safety-preserving explanation but changes the literal quotation. Qualified source and trade review should decide how to teach attribution while retaining exact meaning.

Yesterday's deck cleanup and today's underlayment fastening are separate timepoints. Review deck/support de couverture and product-specific fastening before reusing the archive in speaking or mode targets.
